title: NextGen Social Gathering – Birmingham
description: An afternoon of food, music, games and good conversation. Come on your own or bring a friend, because everyone is welcome and nobody stays a stranger for long.

title: Young Professionals Networking – London
description: Meet young Zambian professionals across tech, finance, health and the creative industries. Short talks, speed-networking and plenty of time to talk.

title: NextGen Football Meetup – Midlands
description: Friendly five-a-side for all abilities, followed by a team lunch. Boots optional, smiles required.

title: Hiking and Adventure Day – Peak District
description: A guided circular walk with stunning views, a packed lunch on the hills and a café stop at the end. Moderate fitness needed.

title: NextGen Cultural Celebration
description: Celebrate Zambian culture with music, dance, chitenge fashion, poetry and traditional food. Young members lead the programme.

title: Basketball Run – Manchester
description: Pick-up basketball games for all levels. Teams are mixed every round so you meet everyone.

title: Coastal Cycle – Edinburgh to Portobello
description: An easy-paced ride along the coast with a beach stop. Bike hire tips shared beforehand.

title: Volunteering Day – Community Food Bank
description: Sort donations and pack food parcels together, then share lunch. A practical way to serve the wider community.

title: CV and Interview Skills Workshop
description: Practical session with recruiters and young professionals: CV reviews, mock interviews and tips for graduate applications.

title: Zambia Heritage Trip – Interest Group
description: Exploring a group trip to Zambia: Lusaka, Livingstone and Mosi-oa-Tunya, plus service projects. Join the first planning call.

title: Community Outreach – Youth Mentoring Afternoon
description: Help run a relaxed mentoring afternoon for teenagers in the wider African community, covering study tips, careers and confidence.

title: Saturday Fitness Bootcamp
description: Outdoor circuits in the park, all fitness levels welcome, with smoothies afterwards.
